aha: Stones and pearls fall when the sand under them is dug: dig the plug under the pearl from the side, then step back sideways so the pearl (and the stone riding on it) drop onto the gate instead of onto you.
deadlocks: Digging straight down beside the stone (column 8): the stone rolls off the pearl and follows you down - crushed.
After digging the plug, stepping down into the shaft below the pearl - crushed by the falling pearl.
